t: A 5 inch ESP32 touch screen with a slot for swappable radio modules.
steps: Buy the CrowPanel Advance 5.0 from the Elecrow store for about 33 US dollars. Add a radio module for LoRa or Zigbee.
Check the hardware version printed on the board. Code differs a little between versions.
Install the free Arduino IDE on your computer.
Add the ESP32 board package in the Arduino IDE.
Download the example code from the Elecrow GitHub page for your board version.
Plug in the panel with the included USB-C cable.
Upload the first touch screen demo from the Elecrow Arduino course.
